articles.title: Putin discusses info threats posed by emerging technologies with Security Council
articles.summary: President Putin held a Friday meeting with permanent members of the Russian Security Council to focus on threats to Russia's information security from emerging technologies and their deployment.

articles.title: Kremlin comments on contact with Turkey over S-400s, Ukraine buffer zone
articles.summary: Kremlin Spokesman Peskov addressed Russia's communication with Turkey regarding S-400 missile systems, the expansion of a buffer zone along the border with Ukraine, and Kiev's attacks on nuclear infrastructure.

articles.title: No phone call from Trump yesterday, but Putin always glad to speak — Kremlin
articles.summary: Kremlin Spokesman Peskov stated that US President Trump was busy and did not contact Putin as planned, but confirmed the Russian president is open to dialogue with his American counterpart.

articles.title: Key statements from President Putin's meeting with Cabinet on fuel situation
articles.summary: President Putin held a cabinet meeting on fuel and transport sectors operations, instructing officials to prioritize fuel supply decisions and noting that current difficulties are temporary while the energy sector maintains high safety margins.

articles.title: Russia-China joint naval drills not aimed against anyone — Kremlin
articles.summary: Kremlin Spokesman Peskov stated that the Russia-China Joint Sea 2026 naval exercise is an important security cooperation measure and not directed against any regional country.
